ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can chart a patient's condition from assessment data, but a nurse must sit down and listen to what lies behind the words, 'I feel that no one understands me.'
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 3,391,000 psychiatric nurses employed in 2024, rising to a projected 3,557,100 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 166,100 jobs and about 189,100 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $93,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace psychiatric nurses, but it will take over documentation and assessment scoring. First drafts of records, scale scoring, and follow-up reminders can be automated, shifting nurses' time from writing toward listening and acting. Psychiatric assessment, medication judgment, and crisis intervention depend heavily on interpersonal trust and remain difficult for machines to replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted emotion recognition and risk alerts, including speech and text analysis
Digital follow-up platforms expand community rehabilitation access
Smart pillboxes and medication-adherence monitoring
Virtual-reality relaxation training supports psychological interventions
ai_s2_auto: Automated scale scoring and assessment-report generation
First drafts of clinical documentation and structured entry
Automated follow-up reminders and appointment management
Electronic medication records and order verification
ai_s3_list: Face-to-face assessment: read a patient's true condition from tone, eye contact, and posture.
Crisis intervention: respond calmly and make decisions during agitation or self-harm incidents.
Therapeutic relationships: earn enough trust for patients to speak honestly.
Family communication and psychological support: build a treatment alliance.
Clinical judgment: the same symptom can mean different things in different people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this occupation in the low-moderate AI exposure range. AI mainly automates documentation, assessments, and follow-up workflows, while licensed professionals still perform evaluation, medication management, intervention, and communication.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure is not a reason to stand still. Digital follow-up and AI risk alerts are already changing the work. Psychiatric nurses who use these tools can spend more time with patients and families, increasing their clinical value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A nursing path requires long-term investment in a bachelor's degree, clinical experience, and advanced education. Psychiatric nursing is a scarce specialty with additional compensation and suits students who genuinely want sustained human interaction. Experience a psychiatric unit through a summer placement or practicum before choosing the field for stability alone.

Before moving from a general ward into psychiatric nursing, complete specialty training and then pursue advanced practice. Build strong scale assessment, medication management, and crisis-intervention skills, learn digital follow-up tools, and move toward community and early-intervention services.

Candidates with nursing backgrounds should add psychiatric credentials. Those without that background can begin as psychiatric assistants or nursing aides before further study. In interviews, emphasize experience handling emotionally intense situations, which often matters more than another certificate.

Psychiatric professionals are consistently difficult to recruit. Retain them through a combination of role allowances, psychological support, and continuing-education paths rather than relying on mission alone. Prioritize candidates familiar with digital follow-up tools.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automated scale scoring and report generation
Flags risk signals in speech and text
Relaxation for anxiety and support for exposure exercises

ai_s7_trends: Digital follow-up and AI risk alerts become standard in psychiatry, freeing nurses from documentation.
Community mental health and early intervention expand, extending roles beyond inpatient units.
Combined assessment, medication, psychological, and digital skills become a core advantage for psychiatric nurses.

body: Advanced practice psychiatric nurses are mental health nursing professionals with advanced clinical training. They assess psychiatric patients, collaborate on diagnosis, manage medications, provide psychotherapy and follow-up education, and connect physicians with patients.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能靠量表数据画出病情曲线，但患者那句「我感觉没人理解我」背后的东西，得护士坐下来听。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年精神科护士在岗约 339.10 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 355.71 万人，净增约 16.61 万个岗位，年均产生约 18.91 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.36 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代精神科护士，但会接管文书和量表：病历初稿、量表评分、随访提醒都能自动化，护士的时间从「写」转向「听和做」。精神评估、用药判断、危机干预这些环节高度依赖人际信任，机器很难替代。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助情绪识别与风险预警（如言语文本分析）
数字化随访平台扩展社区康复触达
智能药盒与用药依从性监测
虚拟现实放松训练辅助心理干预
ai_s2_auto: 量表评分与评估报告自动生成
病历文书初稿与结构化录入
随访提醒与预约管理自动化
用药记录与医嘱核对电子化
ai_s3_list: 面对面评估：从语气、眼神、坐姿捕捉真实状态。
危机干预：躁动、自伤现场的冷静处置与决策。
治疗关系建立：让患者愿意信任、愿意说真话。
家属沟通与心理支持：把治疗同盟建起来。
临床经验判断：同一症状在不同人身上含义不同。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的核心是「人跟人的临床工作」，AI 能自动化的主要是记录、量表、随访等文书流程；评估、用药、干预与沟通仍需执业人员亲力亲为。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于躺平：数字化随访和 AI 风险预警已经在改变工作方式，会用这些工具的精神科护士，能把时间花在更值钱的地方——多接一个患者、多安抚一个家庭，职业价值自然放大。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走护理路线先要接受「本科 + 临床 + 进修」的长期投入。精神科方向稀缺、补贴高，适合真心愿意跟人打交道的孩子；可以先用暑期或实习去精神科病房感受一下，别光听「稳定」二字。
从普通病房转精神科，先补精神科专项培训再谈升执业护士。把量表评估、用药管理和危机干预做扎实，同时学数字化随访工具，往社区与早期干预方向走。
有护理背景的优先补精神科方向资质；没背景的可以从精神科助理/护理员做起再进修。面试时突出你处理高情绪场景的经历，比证书更打动招聘方。
精神科人才难招是常态，建议用「岗位补贴 + 心理减压支持 + 进修通道」组合留人，别只靠情怀。会数字化随访工具的候选人优先。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 量表评分与报告自动生成
言语文本风险信号提示
焦虑放松、暴露训练辅助

ai_s7_trends: 数字化随访与 AI 风险预警成为精神科标配，护士从文书里解放出来。
社区精神卫生与早期干预扩容，岗位从病房延伸到社区。
「评估 + 用药 + 心理 + 数字化」复合能力成为精神科护士的核心竞争力。

body: 精神科执业护士是接受过高级临床训练的精神心理护理专业人员，负责精神科患者评估、诊断协作、用药管理、心理治疗与随访宣教，是精神卫生服务体系中连接医生。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can organize case files, compare timelines, and search precedents, but Coroners still have to determine how a person died by examining the scene and evidence.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 418,000 Coroners were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 430,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 12,300 jobs, with about 33,300 openings annually. The median annual wage was about $78,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Coroners, but it will reshape their desk work. AI can accelerate case-file digitization, timeline analysis, report drafts, and searches of prior cases. Coroners can shift time from forms and files to scene assessment, evidence organization, and cause-of-death determinations. The scarcest output is a conclusion that withstands pressure and review.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted analysis of death-case patterns
Rapid searches of precedents and similar cases
Intelligent comparison of toxicology and examination data
Digital reconstruction of scene images and physical evidence
ai_s2_auto: Digital entry and archiving of case files
Form-based processing of death registrations and certificates
Template-based drafts of examination reports
Automatic organization of case timelines and evidence lists
ai_s3_list: Cause-of-death determination: combining evidence, examinations, and law requires human judgment; AI provides only a reference.
Scene assessment and evidence-collection strategy: experience and intuition guide what to examine first.
Procedural compliance and legal accountability: conclusions must withstand challenges from courts and families.
Communication with families: explaining painful facts requires empathy and restraint.
Multi-party coordination: people organize police, forensic specialists, funeral services, and hospitals into one process.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. About half the work involves files, documents, and reports, which AI can accelerate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean the occupation disappears. Responsibility for death determinations and scene investigations cannot be outsourced. Pure documentation and archive work will shrink. As AI improves, Coroners who exercise judgment and accept accountability become scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Forensic science, medicine, or criminal justice is the standard path, but prepare psychologically and seek field experience early. Build foundations in forensic pathology, evidence rules, and data analysis; an interdisciplinary background is valuable.
Use digital case-management and AI search tools to free time for complex cases. Keep up with advances in forensic pathology. Credentials and a record of completed cases remain the strongest assets.

Nursing, healthcare, and justice backgrounds can provide entry points. Start as an investigator or assistant in a medical examiner's office. Psychological resilience matters more than idealism, and advancement depends on staying effective in frontline work.

Do not hire Coroners based only on education. Assess how many cases they have handled independently and whether their conclusions survived review. Candidates who use AI efficiently without sacrificing procedural rigor merit greater resources.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Integrated registration, progress tracking, and archiving
Manage autopsy, toxicology, and imaging data
Rapid search of similar cases and precedents
Identify mortality patterns and anomaly signals

ai_s7_trends: Case management is becoming fully digital. AI assistance significantly improves desk-work efficiency, while document-focused work continues to shrink.
Cause-of-death determination is combining data with pathology, and cross-agency data integration is becoming standard.
Public-budget pressure keeps job numbers stable, making professional credentials and interdisciplinary skills key differentiators.

body: Coroners investigate unnatural or accidental deaths, organize examinations and cause-of-death determinations, coordinate police, forensic specialists, and funeral providers, issue death certificates, and produce official death findings.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can organize case files, compare timelines, and search precedents, but Coroners still have to determine how a person died by examining the scene and evidence.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能整理案卷、比对时间线、检索判例，但「这个人到底怎么死的」，还是要验尸官在现场和证据里找答案。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年验尸官在岗约 41.80 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 43.03 万人，净增约 1.23 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.33 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代验尸官，但会重塑案件的案头部分。案件档案数字化、时间线梳理、报告初稿和既往案例检索都能交给 AI 提速，验尸官的时间从「填表格、翻案卷」挪向「现场判断、证据组织和死因认定」。真正稀缺的，是扛得住压力、经得起复核的结论。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助的死亡病例模式分析
既往判例与相似案件的快速检索
毒理与检验数据的智能比对
现场影像与物证的数字化重建
ai_s2_auto: 案件档案的数字化录入与归档
死亡登记与证明文书的表单化处理
检验报告的模板化初稿生成
案件时间线与证据清单的自动整理
ai_s3_list: 死因认定：证据、检验与法条的结合判断，AI 只能给参考。
现场判断与取证策略：先看什么、查什么，靠经验和直觉。
程序合规与法律担责：结论要经得起法庭和家属的质疑。
与家属的沟通：把残酷的事实讲清楚，还需要同理心和分寸。
多方协调：警方、法医、殡葬、医院拧成一股绳，靠人来组织。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半工作在案头——档案、文书、报告，这些正是 AI 擅长加速的部分。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中风险不等于岗位消失：死亡认定的责任和现场调查不可外包，被压缩的是纯文书和档案型工作。AI 越强，「会判断、能担责」的验尸官越稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 法医学、医学或刑事司法是正路，但要提前做好心理准备和实习接触。把法医病理、证据规则和数据分析基础都打好，复合背景更吃香。
把数字化案件管理和 AI 检索工具用起来，把时间从案头释放到复杂案件上。持续跟进修法医病理进展，资质和案例积累才是硬通货。
护理、医疗或司法背景都可以切入，先从法医办公室调查员或助理做起。心理韧性比情怀重要，能坚持住一线工作的人才有机会往上升。
招验尸官别只看学历，要看独立办过多少案件、结论经不经得起复核。愿意用 AI 提效又不牺牲程序严谨的候选人，值得给更多资源。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 尸检、毒理、影像数据管理
死亡数据上报、统计分析
死亡模式、异常信号识别

ai_s7_trends: 案件管理全面数字化，AI 辅助让案头效率显著提升，文书型工作持续压缩。
死因认定向「数据 + 病理」结合演进，跨机构数据联动成为趋势。
公共预算压力下，岗位数量趋稳，专业资质与复合能力成为分水岭。

body: 验尸官（Coroners）负责调查非自然或意外死亡案件，组织尸体检验与死因认定，协调警方、法医与殡葬机构，签发死亡证明并形成官方死亡结论。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate peak-hour staffing and detergent inventory, but Dishwashers still have to clear a sink full of plates during the busiest ten minutes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 477,700 Dishwashers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 478,600 by 2034. That represents about 900 additional jobs and roughly 76,800 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $33,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Dishwashers, but it will improve management. Systems can handle smart scheduling, supply inventory, and predictive equipment maintenance, while the core job remains physical. Commercial dishwashers have replaced most hand washing, but people still scrape, sort, load, unload, and stack items. AI primarily changes how the work is managed, not how dishes are washed.
ai_s2_accel: Automatic monitoring of water temperature and chemicals in smart dishwashers
Smart dispatching and staffing recommendations during peak periods
Predictive equipment-maintenance alerts
Digital management of tableware inventory and losses
ai_s2_auto: Systematic scheduling and attendance tracking
Automatic replenishment of detergent and other supplies
Smart cleaning programs and automatic chemical dispensing in dishwashing machines
Digital records for broken tableware and repair requests
ai_s3_list: Peak-hour pace: clearing a sink full of dirty plates in ten minutes depends on speed and proper sequencing.
Hygiene judgment: identify items that need extra attention and know when they are clean enough.
Equipment response: resolve jams and shutdowns quickly on site.
Strength and stamina: the ability to stand all day in a hot, humid environment is fundamental.
Kitchen teamwork: know when to move faster and where to assist so the workflow stays smooth.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places Dishwashers in the relatively low AI exposure range. Systems increasingly optimize scheduling, inventory, and equipment, but cleaning itself is physical work with limited automation potential.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean no change. Commercial machines already perform most washing, leaving manual work before and after each cycle plus hygiene execution. The occupation's real ceiling comes from pay and advancement paths, not AI.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Dishwashing can serve as a short-term bridge or an entry into food service, but it is a weak long-term plan by itself. Anyone seeking a food-service career should start learning kitchen-assistant tasks and progress toward cooking, baking, or restaurant management.

Build a reputation for clean work and a steady pace, while actively learning basic ingredient preparation and kitchen-assistant skills. Food-service teams value both practical skill and reliability, and diligent workers are more likely to be noticed and promoted.

Dishwashing has one of the lowest barriers for people who need work quickly. Set a direction after starting, learn other kitchen skills on the job, and avoid letting the role become repetitive work with no exit.
High turnover among Dishwashers is rooted in pay and respect. Reasonable schedules, suitable equipment, and a clear advancement path retain kitchen staff better than constant replacement hiring.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic chemical dispensing and concentration monitoring
Inventory of detergent and disposable supplies

ai_s7_trends: Commercial dishwashers and automated cleaning equipment continue to reduce purely manual washing.
Smart scheduling and supply management reduce kitchen-management costs and standardize the role.
Job growth for Dishwashers is limited, making transitions into kitchen assistance, cooking, and food-service management the main advancement route.

body: Dishwashers clean, sanitize, and organize tableware, cookware, and some kitchen utensils. They maintain cleanliness and hygiene standards in the dish area and provide essential support for normal kitchen operations.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate peak-hour staffing and detergent inventory, but Dishwashers still have to clear a sink full of plates during the busiest ten minutes.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你算高峰期的排班和洗剂库存，但「高峰期那十分钟怎么把这一池盘子顶过去」，还得洗碗工自己来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年洗碗工在岗约 47.77 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 47.86 万人，净增约 0.09 万个岗位，年均产生约 7.68 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.37 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代洗碗工，但会优化管理端。智能排班、耗材库存、设备预测性维护都能交给系统，洗碗工本身做的是实打实的体力活。商用洗碗机替代了手洗的大部分，但刮盘、分类、放机、取出、码放这些环节仍然需要人，AI 主要影响的是「怎么管」，而不是「怎么洗」。
ai_s2_accel: 智能洗碗机的水温药液自动监控
高峰期的智能调度与人员调配建议
设备的预测性维护提醒
餐具盘点与损耗的数字化管理
ai_s2_auto: 排班与考勤的系统化
洗涤剂等耗材的自动补货
洗碗机的智能清洗程序与自动注液
破损餐具与报修记录的数字化
ai_s3_list: 高峰节奏：一池脏盘子在十分钟里顶过去，靠的是手速和排序。
卫生判断：哪些餐具要重点处理、什么程度算干净，眼力要准。
设备应急：机器卡住、停摆时，现场要能快速处理。
体力与耐力：湿热环境里站一天，扛得住才是根本。
与后厨的默契：什么时候该快、哪里需要搭把手，配合出来才顺。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这行的管理环节——排班、库存、设备——正被系统优化，但清洗本身是体力活，自动化替代有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低风险不等于没变化：商用洗碗机已经替代了大部分手洗，剩下的岗位价值在「机器前后的手工环节」和卫生执行。这个岗位真正的天花板不是 AI，而是薪资和晋升通道。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 洗碗工适合作为短期过渡或餐饮入门，不适合当长期规划。真想在餐饮发展，从后厨帮厨做起，往厨师、面点或餐饮管理方向走，才有上升空间。
把洗得干净、节奏稳当做出口碑，同时主动学食材初加工和帮厨技能。餐饮圈认手艺也认人，勤快踏实的人容易被记住、被提拔。
需要快速上岗挣钱的，洗碗工门槛最低；但入职后要给自己定方向，边干边学后厨其他技能，别让这份工作变成没有出口的重复劳动。
洗碗工流动率高，根子在于待遇和尊重。给合理的排班、配好洗碗设备、明确晋升通道，比不断招新人更能稳住后厨的人手。

ai_s7_trends: 商用洗碗机与自动清洗设备普及，纯手洗环节持续减少。
智能排班和耗材管理降低后厨管理成本，岗位向标准化演进。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. Supervisors who use intelligent irrigation, drone inspections, and cost software work more efficiently. Loose management based only on experience will lose in cost competition.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Landscaping and horticulture studies offer broad employment options. Starting in front-line grounds maintenance and advancing into supervision or project management is common. The work is physically demanding and outdoors, with busy and slow seasons, so it suits people who accept those conditions.

Learn cost calculations and intelligent maintenance tools, and pursue landscaping credentials. Advance toward project or regional management by learning budgets and project negotiations, not only crew leadership.

People with experience in construction management, property services, warehousing, or logistics can transition into landscaping management. Lead crews on site to learn landscaping workflows before pursuing project management. Emphasize leadership and cost awareness in interviews.

Employers need supervisors who understand costs and lead people. Use project incentives and advancement training to retain them. Equip crews with scheduling and location tools, then replace constant watching with quality spot checks.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic irrigation based on soil moisture
Real-time labor and material cost calculations

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent irrigation, drone inspections, and other smart maintenance tools become standard.
Market-based landscaping maintenance makes cost control a competitive requirement.
Supervisors shift from crew foremen toward project managers who understand budgets and operations.

body: First Line Supervisors Of Landscaping, Lawn Service, And Groundskeeping Workers manage front-line landscaping and lawn-care operations. They organize planting, trimming, maintenance, and cleanup, schedule crews, inspect quality, and manage equipment and materials.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can schedule crews, calculate costs, and inspect with drones, but supervisors still verify whether hedges are even and workers completed the job correctly.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你排班、算成本、无人机巡检，但「这排绿篱修剪得齐不齐、工人今天的活干没干到位」，还得主管到现场用眼睛验货。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年主管工人在岗约 22.47 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 23.00 万人，净增约 0.53 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.32 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.62 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代园林绿化主管，但会接管一部分管理活：智能排班、GPS 作业追踪、无人机巡检、成本核算都在普及。现场质量把关、工人调度和客户沟通是「人到现场」的活，AI 只能辅助，不能替主管站在工地。
ai_s2_accel: 智能灌溉系统按土壤湿度自动浇水
无人机巡检大项目作业进度
园林设计软件辅助方案沟通
设备维护的预防性提醒
ai_s2_auto: 排班与派工的软件化
作业位置的 GPS 追踪
工时与成本核算自动化
客户验收报告的电子化
ai_s3_list: 现场验货：修剪、种植、养护的质量判断。
带队伍：让工人听指挥、出活快。
成本平衡：保质量又控成本。
客户沟通：把需求变成可执行的任务。
应急处理：天气、设备、工人的突发状况。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这行的自动化集中在「排班、定位、成本」这些管理数据层，真正的质量把关和现场调度要靠主管的眼睛和嘴巴；智能工具越普及，会看数据、会控成本的主管越吃香。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：智慧养护在普及，会用智能灌溉、无人机巡检、成本软件的主管效率更高；只会「凭经验蛮干」的粗放管理，会在成本竞争中被淘汰。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 园林、园艺专业就业面不窄，从一线养护工做起、往主管项目经理走是常见路径。提醒孩子这行是户外辛苦活，适合能吃苦、爱户外的人，旺季晒、淡季闲要想清楚。
把成本核算、智慧养护工具学起来，考园林绿化相关证书。往项目经理、区域主管走，学会管预算和谈项目，别停在「只会带工干活」的层面。
有工程管理、物业、仓储物流经验的人转园林管理有优势。先做现场带班熟悉绿化工序，再谈项目管理；面试时强调你的带队和成本意识。
主管缺的是「懂成本又会带人」的复合型，用「项目提成 + 培训晋升」留人。给班组配好排班和定位工具，质量抽查代替全天盯人，效率更高。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 作业位置与进度实时掌握
设计效果辅助客户确认
人工材料成本实时核算

ai_s7_trends: 智能灌溉、无人机巡检等智慧养护成为标配。
绿化养护市场化，成本控制能力决定竞争力。
主管从「带工头」转向「项目经理」，会预算会运营。

body: 园林与草坪作业主管指园林绿化与草坪养护作业的一线管理者，负责组织工人完成种植、修剪、养护、保洁等作业，安排排班与分工，监督质量，管理设备与材料。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate genetic risk in seconds, but a counselor still sits with the family and explains what the result means for their lives.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 4,000 counselors in 2024, projected to rise to 4,300 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 300 jobs, with roughly 300 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $98,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Genetic counselors, but it changes how reports are interpreted. Literature review and risk calculations that once took days can now produce rapid suggestions and warnings. A person still has to explain the result, support the family, and guide choices. Stronger AI increases the value of counselors who communicate clearly and respond to emotion.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted pedigree analysis: systems draw family trees and flag inheritance patterns
Gene-phenotype matching: tools recommend clues for rare-disease diagnosis
Patient education generation: systems produce accessible explanatory materials
Remote genetic counseling: AI-assisted online services extend access
ai_s2_auto: Automated genetic report interpretation: AI annotates variants and provides initial risk flags
Genetic risk calculation: models estimate disease and inheritance probabilities
Literature and knowledge-base search: tools match current clinical guidance
Electronic consultation records: systems generate structured notes and follow-up reminders
ai_s3_list: Explain complex risk in plain language so families understand each probability in a report.
Provide emotional support and empathy when families receive difficult results.
Guide decisions and protect ethical boundaries around interventions and reproductive choices.
Combine report findings with the patient's condition and family context.
Build professional trust across physicians, patients, and families.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a moderate AI exposure range. AI accelerates report interpretation, risk calculation, and literature review, while communication, emotional support, and decision guidance remain central human work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high replacement risk. AI calculates probabilities, but people explain what those probabilities mean to a family. Entry-level roles limited to reading reports face pressure, while experienced counselors with empathy and decision-guidance skills gain value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study biology, medicine, or genetics before pursuing a master's degree in genetic counseling. Certification systems in China are developing, and overseas certification is another route. Build communication and empathy alongside scientific knowledge.
Use AI interpretation tools and devote the saved time to communication and a specialty such as prenatal, cancer, or rare-disease counseling. Let tools extend your ability to explain complex findings.

A medical background supports career transition. Start in medical liaison or report interpretation at a genetic testing company, then add genetic counseling credentials. Quantify consultation volume and patient satisfaction on your resume.

Do not hire only for research ability. Assess communication and resilience. Candidates who interpret AI-supported reports, explain results with care, and handle emotional strain are harder to find and retain.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Variant annotation, pathogenicity classification, and interpretation guidance
Current clinical guidance, medication information, and follow-up recommendations
Automatic pedigree drawing and inheritance-pattern prompts
Generates plain-language reports and visual explanations
Structured follow-up, reminders, and longitudinal data

ai_s7_trends: Wider genetic testing in prenatal screening, cancer, and rare disease is raising demand. Qualified counselors remain in short supply.
AI handles more report interpretation and risk calculation, shifting counselor value toward communication, decision guidance, and psychological support.
China's genetic counseling credentials and career structure are developing, while hospitals and testing companies add dedicated roles.

body: Genetic counselors interpret genetic tests, assess inherited family risk, explain disease and intervention choices, and assist physicians with screening and care planning.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate genetic risk in seconds, but a counselor still sits with the family and explains what the result means for their lives.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能秒算遗传风险概率，但「这个结果对你们家意味着什么」这句话，还得咨询师坐下来慢慢讲。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年遗传咨询师在岗约 0.40 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.43 万人，净增约 0.03 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.03 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.89 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代遗传咨询师，但会改变「解读报告」的姿势。以前查文献、算风险概率要花几天，现在 AI 工具能快速生成解读建议、风险提示。可这些结果最终要落到一个具体家庭身上——怎么讲、怎么陪、怎么选，是人的工作。AI 越强大，能接住情绪、讲清选择的人越稀缺。
ai_s2_accel: AI 家系分析辅助：自动绘制家系图并提示遗传模式
基因-表型匹配：罕见病诊断线索自动推荐
患者教育内容生成：自动产出通俗化科普材料
远程遗传咨询：AI 辅助的线上咨询扩大服务半径
ai_s2_auto: 基因报告自动解读：AI 生成变异注释与初步风险提示
遗传风险概率计算：模型自动评估患病与遗传概率
文献检索与知识库：一键匹配最新临床指南
咨询记录电子化：结构化病历与随访提醒自动生成
ai_s3_list: 把复杂风险讲成人话：一份报告里的每个概率，怎么让家属真正听懂。
情感支持与共情：面对坏结果，怎么接住眼泪、怎么给希望，机器替代不了。
决策引导与伦理把关：干预方案、生育选择，每一步都涉及价值观判断。
临床综合判断：报告之外的患者情况、家庭背景，要放到一起权衡。
多学科协作与信任：和医生、患者、家属之间建立的专业信任，是长期资产。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有相当一部分工作在桌面完成——报告解读、风险计算、文献检索正被 AI 大幅加速，但咨询沟通、情感支持、决策引导这些核心，AI 只能辅助。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 能算概率，但「这个结果对你们家意味着什么」需要人来回答。真正被压缩的是「只会念报告、不会沟通」的初级职能，AI 让这类环节变得廉价；能共情、会决策引导的资深咨询师，价值反而上升。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 本科读生物、医学、遗传学，硕士再走遗传咨询方向（国内认证体系在建设中，海外认证也是通路）。重点练沟通和共情能力，别只当「书呆子」。AI 时代，能讲清楚、能接住情绪的人最稀缺。
把 AI 解读工具用起来，把省下的时间花在沟通技巧和亚方向深耕上（产前、肿瘤、罕见病）。别让 AI 替代了你的「读报告」，要让它放大你的「讲人话」。
医疗背景转行有优势，可先从基因检测公司医学联络、报告解读岗切入，再补遗传咨询认证。简历上写「咨询案例数、患者满意度」这类可量化成果。
招咨询师别只看科研能力，要看沟通和抗压。能读懂 AI 报告、又能把结果讲得有人情味、扛得住情感负荷的候选人，比纯学术背景的人更难找、更值得留。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 变异注释、致病性分级、解读建议
患病概率、遗传模式分析
最新临床指南、用药与随访建议
自动绘谱、遗传模式提示
基因-表型匹配、候选基因推荐
通俗化报告、图文讲解生成
结构化随访、提醒与数据沉淀

ai_s7_trends: 基因检测全面普及，产前筛查、肿瘤基因检测、罕见病诊断铺开，遗传咨询需求持续上升，专业人才长期供不应求。
AI 接管报告解读和风险计算，咨询师的核心价值转向沟通、决策引导与心理支持，资深咨询师溢价明显。
国内遗传咨询认证与职业体系逐步完善，医院与检测公司的专职咨询岗位数量明显增长。

body: 遗传咨询师负责解读基因检测结果、评估家族遗传风险、为患者和家庭提供疾病风险与干预选择的咨询，并协助医生制定筛查与诊疗方案，是连接「分子生物学」与「临床决策」。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能秒算遗传风险概率，但「这个结果对你们家意味着什么」这句话，还得咨询师坐下来慢慢讲。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate maps and analyze core imagery almost instantly, but technicians still use their eyes and hammers to describe field sections and log each core interval.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 9,800 workers in 2024, projected to rise to 10,000 by 2034. That is a net gain of about 200 jobs, with roughly 1,300 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $48,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will replace some office work performed by Geological Technicians, but the occupation will remain. AI and software are taking over mapping, data organization, and preliminary interpretation, placing the greatest pressure on office-only drafting roles. Field surveys, sampling, drilling support, and on-site judgment still require people. Technicians who use AI as a tool can leave routine drafting behind and focus on higher-value fieldwork.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted lithology recognition and stratigraphic correlation
Automated 3D geological modeling
Widespread drone imaging and remote-sensing interpretation
Unified platform management of borehole data
ai_s2_auto: Automatic and assisted geological map generation
Template-based data organization and reporting
AI recognition of core and outcrop imagery
Automatic processing and interpretation of geophysical data
ai_s3_list: Field observation and recognition: identify lithology, structures, and sequences through direct judgment.
Sampling and logging craft: location, depth, and representativeness directly affect conclusions.
Field safety and emergency response: people manage mountain roads, weather, and rockfall risks.
Project-site coordination: people communicate with drilling crews, clients, and contractors.
Data quality assurance: technicians verify whether rapid AI-generated maps are accurate and usable.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a moderate AI exposure range. AI is taking over many desktop tasks, including mapping, organization, and preliminary interpretation, with clear productivity gains.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. AI replaces office processes, while field execution, on-site judgment, and data quality assurance become more important. Technicians limited to drafting face pressure, while those who work in the field, understand data, and verify AI results become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study geology, resource exploration, or geotechnical engineering and join field internships during breaks. Develop both field fundamentals and 3D modeling skills. Do not focus only on office drafting, which is among the fastest-automating tasks.

Adopt 3D geological modeling, remote-sensing interpretation, and AI mapping tools while volunteering for field projects. Progress from drafting technician to a multidisciplinary field-and-data technician, and pursue the fundamentals examination for geotechnical registration where applicable.

People with earth science backgrounds transition most easily. Others can begin as samplers or field assistants at investigation institutes. Resumes should specify projects, field days, and geophysical and mapping software experience.

Do not hire technicians only for software proficiency. Evaluate field capability and responsibility. Candidates who accept field assignments, handle data carefully, and verify AI outputs are more valuable than those limited to drafting.

ai_s7_trends: AI mapping and preliminary interpretation are spreading, reducing office-only drafting roles and shifting technicians toward field execution, data verification, and on-site judgment.
Infrastructure investigation, mineral exploration, and hazard prevention support demand, with multidisciplinary field-and-data technicians increasingly valued.
3D modeling and remote-sensing interpretation are becoming standard, geological data is moving onto platforms, and data skill requirements continue to rise.

body: Geological Technicians execute fieldwork and process data for geological surveys and engineering investigations. They observe geology, collect geotechnical samples, organize test data, and prepare maps and reports to support construction.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate maps and analyze core imagery almost instantly, but technicians still use their eyes and hammers to describe field sections and log each core interval.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动成图、秒读岩芯图像，但野外那条剖面到底怎么描述、岩芯那截怎么编录，还得靠技术员的眼睛和锤子。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年地质技术员（不含水文技术员）在岗约 0.98 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.00 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.13 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 会替代一部分地质技术员的内业工作，但不会让岗位消失。制图、数据整理、初步解释正被 AI 和软件接管，纯内业绘图岗受冲击最大；但野外调查、采样执行、钻探配合和现场判断仍需要人——把 AI 当工具用的技术员，反而能从绘图里解放出来做更有价值的现场工作。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助岩性识别与地层对比
三维地质建模自动化
无人机航拍与遥感解译普及
钻孔数据平台化统一管理
ai_s2_auto: 地质图件自动生成与辅助成图
数据整理与报告模板化
岩芯与露头图像 AI 识别
物探数据自动处理解释
ai_s3_list: 野外观察与识别：岩性、构造、层序，眼睛和锤子的判断。
采样与编录的手艺：采样位置、深度、代表性，差一点结论就偏。
野外安全与应急：山路、天气、落石，现场安全靠人。
项目现场的协调：与钻机队、甲方、施工方沟通，人来对接。
数据质量的把关：AI 成图再快，能不能用、对不对，技术员来核。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有一半以上桌面任务正被 AI 接手——制图、整理、初步解释，效率提升明显。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 替代的是「内业」环节，野外执行、现场判断和数据处理把关反而更重要。真正被挤压的是纯绘图技术员，会野外、懂数据、能复核 AI 结果的技术员更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选地质学、资源勘查或岩土工程专业，假期跟队野外实习。把野外基本功和三维建模都练起来，别只学室内绘图——那正是 AI 替代最快的部分。
把三维地质建模、遥感解译和 AI 成图工具用起来，主动承担野外项目。从「画图技术员」升级为「野外+数据」复合技术员，考注册岩土基础。
有地学背景转行最顺，无背景可从勘察院采样员、野外助手做起。简历上多写「参与过哪些项目、野外天数、会哪些物探和成图软件」。
招技术员别只看软件熟练度，要看野外能力和责任心。肯下野外、数据心细、能复核 AI 成果的候选人，比只会画图的更值得留。

ai_s7_trends: AI 制图与初步解释普及，纯内业绘图岗收缩，技术员转向「野外执行+数据复核+现场判断」。
基建勘察、矿产勘查与灾害防治需求支撑行业，会野外懂数据的复合技术员更抢手。
三维建模与遥感解译成为标配，地质数据平台化，技术员的数据技能要求持续提高。

body: 地质技术员负责地质调查与工程勘察的现场执行和数据处理，包括野外地质观察、岩土采样、试验数据整理、地质制图与报告编制，为工程建设。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AGV robots can move standard boxes, but people still handle loads with uneven sizes, weights, and awkward positions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 2,988,900 hand laborers and freight, stock, and material movers employed in 2024, projected to reach 3,033,100 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 44,200 jobs, with roughly 384,300 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $38,900 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation will not immediately replace hand material movers, but they will gradually take over standardized work. Automated sortation, AGVs, and driverless forklifts reduce demand in predictable settings. Irregular loading, on-site adaptation, and mixed-product handling still depend on people. Moving from pure physical labor toward equipment and process skills offers a more stable path.
ai_s2_accel: AI scheduling and task assignment improve productivity
Smart dispatch reduces unnecessary movement
Wearable devices support loading work and monitor fatigue
Electronic labels and automatic identification speed scanning
ai_s2_auto: Automated sortation replaces manual sorting
AGV robots move standardized containers
Scanning automates inventory counts and reconciliation
Driverless forklifts take over fixed-route transport
ai_s3_list: Irregular loads: judge how to handle unusual, fragile, or overweight goods.
On-site adaptation: respond flexibly to changed orders, rush jobs, and emergency shipments.
Damage detection: spot packaging and product problems visually.
Mixed-product handling: use experience to move different specifications together.
Safety judgment: avoid injury in a fast-paced environment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score indicates low-moderate AI exposure during a gradual automation transition. Machines increasingly handle standard boxes and fixed routes, but end-to-end unmanned operations remain distant. Last-mile loading, irregular items, and urgent tasks still require many workers as the job changes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. Purely physical roles will gradually shrink, while workers who operate forklifts, understand warehouse systems, and use new equipment become scarcer in automated facilities. Combining physical work with technical skill offers greater stability.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not treat manual material handling as a long-term plan. For people with limited formal education, a trade or equipment skill such as forklift operation, welding, or electrical work provides more resilience. Use material handling as a transition, not the destination.
Earn a forklift credential and learn warehouse systems while working peak seasons. Material movers who actively build equipment skills can advance in both pay and stability.

This role offers a quick, low-barrier transition with daily work and pay. For a longer career, move early toward sortation supervision, warehouse dispatch, or equipment operation rather than remaining in pure physical labor.

During peak seasons, combine automated equipment with flexible human staffing to reduce turnover in purely physical roles. Provide advancement paths for workers willing to earn credentials and learn systems.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatically route parcels by shipping label
Automatically schedule for peak and slow seasons

ai_s7_trends: AGVs and automated sortation increasingly replace standardized transport, shrinking purely physical roles.
Equipment operation and warehouse-system skills become the main transition path for material movers.
Last-mile loading and irregular-item handling will retain human labor, but require broader skills.

body: Hand material movers primarily use physical labor to load, unload, move, stack, sort, and count goods. They are a foundational execution layer in warehousing, logistics, and retail supply chains, keeping goods flowing smoothly between stages.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AGV robots can move standard boxes, but people still handle loads with uneven sizes, weights, and awkward positions.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AGV 机器人能搬标准箱子，但一车「大小不一、轻重不均、位置刁钻」的货，还得靠人一双手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年劳工与货运、物料搬运工、手工在岗约 298.89 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 303.31 万人，净增约 4.42 万个岗位，年均产生约 38.43 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.89 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化不会立刻取代搬运工，但会逐步接管「标准化」的部分：自动分拣线、AGV、无人叉车正在吃掉规则场景的搬运需求。剩下的不规则货物装卸、现场应变、多品类混搬，仍是人力主场。对个人来说，从「纯体力」转向「会设备 + 懂流程」是更稳的路。
ai_s2_accel: AI 排班与任务派发优化人效
智能调度系统减少无效搬运
穿戴式设备辅助装卸监测疲劳
电子标签与自动识别提速扫码
ai_s2_auto: 自动分拣线替代手工分拣
AGV 机器人搬运标准化货箱
扫码盘点与库存自动对账
无人叉车接管固定路线搬运
ai_s3_list: 异形件处理：不规则、易碎、超重货物的装卸判断。
现场应变：临时改单、加塞、紧急出库的灵活处置。
破损识别：肉眼发现货物与包装的异常。
多品类混搬：不同规格货物同时作业的经验。
安全判断：在快节奏里保护自己不受伤。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明搬运行业正处「逐步自动化」的过渡期：规则场景（标准箱、固定路线）正在被机器接管，但全链路无人化还很远。末端装卸、异形件和临时任务依然大量用人，只是岗位内容在变化。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于没变化：不学新技能的纯体力岗位会被慢慢压缩，而会开叉车、懂仓库系统、能操作新设备的工人，在自动化仓库里反而更稀缺。把力气活干成「力气 + 技能活」，才是稳的。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不建议把体力搬运当长期规划。如果孩子学历不高，优先学一门手艺或设备操作（叉车、焊工、电工），比纯体力岗位抗 AI 冲击得多；搬运可以作为过渡，别当终点。
旺季赚钱的同时，考个叉车证、学学仓储系统操作，往设备岗和班组长方向走。主动学新技能的搬运工，薪资和稳定性都会上一个台阶。
适合需要快速上手的过渡期：干一天结一天、门槛低。想长期干，建议入行后尽快往分拣主管、仓储调度或设备操作转型，别让自己停在纯体力层。
旺季用工可考虑自动化设备 + 人工机动结合，减少纯体力岗位流失。对愿意考证、学系统的工人给晋升通道，能显著降低旺季高流失率。

ai_s7_trends: 标准化搬运加速被 AGV 与自动分拣取代，纯体力岗位持续收缩。
「设备操作 + 仓储系统」技能成为搬运工转型的核心方向。
末端装卸与异形件处理将长期保留人工，但要求更复合的技能。

body: 手工搬运工负责以体力为主完成货物的装卸、搬运、码放、分拣与清点，是仓储物流与零售供应链中最基础的执行环节，保障货物在各个环节顺畅流转。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Scanning can capture shape, but technicians still decide how to modify and adjust a device and whether it fits.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 12,000 medical appliance technicians employed in 2024, projected to rise to 12,400 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 400 jobs, with roughly 1,500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $47,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace medical appliance technicians, but it will reduce casting work. 3D scanning and automated forming accelerate rough blanks, shifting work from mold replication toward practiced model modification, fitting adjustments, and individual customization. People who only make rough blanks face displacement, while those who adjust and customize devices become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Model-parameter optimization
Fit recommendations
Risk Alert
Production scheduling optimization
ai_s2_auto: Automatic 3D shape capture
Automatic rough-blank forming
Automatic record generation
Follow-up reminders
ai_s3_list: Model-modification touch: people ensure fit.
Fitting adjustments: people judge the experience.
Individual customization: people exercise discretion.
Maintenance and refurbishment: people apply experience.
Patient communication: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score places this occupation in a medium-to-high-exposure category. Shape capture and forming become faster, but adjustment and customization remain human work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces mold replication and rough-blank work, not fitting and customization. People who adjust and customize devices become scarcer as demand grows, while workers limited to rough blanks face risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in prosthetics/orthotics and practice model modification and fitting. Pure rough-blank work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop practiced touch early.
Advance from rough blanks to model modification + customization and learn scan-based modeling.
Highlight training and manual skill and specify the devices you have handled.
Do not select candidates solely for speed; assess whether they can adjust devices to fit. Core workers deserve higher piece-rate pay.

ai_s7_trends: Scanning and forming spread.
Aging increases demand.
People who customize devices are more sought after.

body: Medical appliance technicians follow prescriptions to capture and modify models, manufacture and adjust prostheses, orthoses, and other medical assistive devices, form and assemble them, and perform fitting calibration to assure fit and compensatory function.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Scanning can capture shape, but technicians still decide how to modify and adjust a device and whether it fits.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代医疗器具技师，但会压缩取型环节。三维扫描与自动成型把粗胚提速，工作从「翻模」挪向「修模手感、试穿调整、个性定制」。真正被挤掉的是只做粗胚的人，会调会定制的人更值钱。

适配推荐
风险预警
排产优化
ai_s2_auto: 三维自动取型
粗胚自动成型

ai_s3_list: 修模手感：合身靠人。
试穿调整：体验靠人。

患者沟通：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光区——取型与成型被加速，但调整与定制还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「翻模粗胚」动作，不是「试穿定制」的岗位。会调会定制的人，反而随需求更稀缺。怕的是只会做粗胚。

从「粗胚」升级成「修模 + 定制」，学扫描建模。
突出培训与手感，写清跟过哪些器具。
选人别只看快，要看会不会调合身。骨干值得给高件工。

ai_s7_trends: 扫描成型普及。
老龄化需求增。
会定制的人更抢手。

body: 医疗器具技师依处方取型修模，制作并调整假肢矫形器等医疗辅具，成型装配并试穿校准，保障贴合与代偿功能。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate risk probabilities from sensor data, but safety professionals still need their own voices and feet to make workers wear helmets and sign corrective-action orders.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show that about 31,900 occupational health and safety specialists and technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 34,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,700 jobs, with roughly 3,400 openings per year and a median annual wage of about $58,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace occupational health and safety specialists, but it will take over data and analysis. Sensor monitoring, AI image recognition of hazards, and predictive risk models are replacing labor-intensive inspections. People remain essential for on-site confirmation, driving corrective action, investigating accidents, and assigning responsibility.
ai_s2_accel: AI risk-prediction models assist tiered controls
Wearable devices monitor employee condition
Data-driven review and analysis of accident causes
Remote video inspection and intelligent alerts
ai_s2_auto: Sensors and intelligent monitoring replace manual data collection
AI image recognition automatically flags safety hazards
Automatic generation of risk registers and reports
Systematic management of training records and certificates
ai_s3_list: On-site risk judgment: AI flags a hazard, but human experience determines whether an accident could occur and how serious it could be.
Driving corrective action and communication: expertise and influence make production teams take corrections seriously.
Accident investigation and assignment of responsibility: reconstructing the site and clarifying the chain require human logic and judgment.
Training and education: getting workers to listen and act correctly is an art of communication.
Regulatory and compliance judgment: people interpret the practical limits behind rules.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 reflects the large share of data collection, risk analysis, and reporting in this occupation, tasks AI and sensors are rapidly taking over.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. AI makes discovery faster and more comprehensive, pushing safety professionals toward confirmation and correction, an irreplaceable part of the safety chain. Roles limited to forms and procedures face pressure, while experts who judge conditions and drive corrective action remain scarce.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Safety engineering is an enduring, regulation-driven field. Build strong knowledge of regulations, risk engineering, and occupational hygiene, and prepare early for the Registered Safety Engineer exam. In the AI era, professionals who interpret data and exercise on-site judgment are more competitive.

Use AI monitoring and risk models as assistants, and spend the saved time driving corrective action and training. Earn Registered Safety Engineer credentials and advance toward EHS management or third-party consulting rather than remaining in checklist work.

People with science, engineering, or manufacturing backgrounds have an advantage when transitioning. First earn a safety officer or Registered Safety Engineer qualification and start in corporate safety. Quantify resume achievements, such as driving completion of XX corrective actions or participating in XX accident investigations.

Do not hire safety officers based on credentials alone. Ask candidates to propose corrective actions for a hazard scenario to test whether they stand firm or merely follow procedures. People with on-site judgment who accept responsibility deserve stronger offers.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic collection of gas, noise, and dust data
Cameras automatically flag accidents and hazards
Closed-loop corrective action, registers, and training management

ai_s7_trends: Sensors and AI fully take over risk monitoring, shifting safety professionals from manual inspection toward confirmation and correction and raising their on-site value.
Tighter workplace-safety regulations and ESG requirements expand corporate EHS teams and demand for third-party services.
Credentials such as Registered Safety Engineer become career dividing lines, with clear premiums for people who combine certification and on-site experience.

body: Occupational health and safety specialists and technicians identify, assess, and control workplace health and safety risks. They inspect hazards, provide safety training, investigate accidents, review compliance, and help employers implement occupational safety and health management.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate risk probabilities from sensor data, but safety professionals still need their own voices and feet to make workers wear helmets and sign corrective-action orders.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能从传感器数据里算出风险概率，但让工人把那顶安全帽戴上、把那条整改单签字，还得靠安全员一张嘴两条腿。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年职业健康与安全专员及技术员在岗约 3.19 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.46 万人，净增约 0.27 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.34 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.84 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代职业健康与安全专员，但会接管数据与分析。传感器监测、AI 图像识别隐患、风险模型预测，正在替代「人海式巡查」。剩下的现场确认、整改推动、事故调查和责任认定，是人的核心，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 风险预测模型辅助分级管控
可穿戴设备监测员工状态
事故原因的数据化复盘分析
远程视频巡检与智能告警
ai_s2_auto: 传感器与智能监测替代人工采集
AI 图像识别自动标注安全隐患
风险台账与报告自动生成
培训记录与证书管理系统化
ai_s3_list: 现场风险判断：AI 标出隐患，但「会不会出事、多严重」得靠人的经验定级。
整改推动与沟通：让生产部把整改当真，靠的是专业和影响力。
事故调查与责任认定：还原现场、厘清链条，需要人的逻辑与判断。
培训宣教：让工人听得进去、做得到位，是门沟通艺术。
法规与合规判断：制度背后的尺度，得靠人来拿捏。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业的数据采集、风险分析、报告比重较高，这些正被 AI 和传感器快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 把「发现」做快做全，反而把安全员推向「确认与整改」——那是安全链条上 AI 替代不了的一环。真正被挤压的是「只会填表走流程」的岗位，能现场判断、推动整改的安全专家依然稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 安全工程是法规驱动的长青赛道。读专业时把法规、风险工程和职业卫生学扎实，尽早备考注册安全工程师；AI 时代，会看数据、能现场判断的复合型人才更吃香。
把 AI 监测和风险模型当助手，省下时间做整改推动和培训。考注安证、往 EHS 经理或第三方咨询方向走，别只停留在「查表记录」。
有理工、工程、制造背景者转型有优势。先考注安或安全员资格，从企业安全员做起，简历里多写「推动完成XX项整改、参与过XX事故调查」这类经历。
招安全员别只看证，要看过往「敢不敢坚持」。面试时给个隐患场景问整改推动方案，能筛掉只会走流程的；有现场判断力、敢担责的人值得高配。

摄像头自动标注意外与隐患
心率、疲劳与异常状态预警
整改闭环、台账与培训管理

ai_s7_trends: 传感器与 AI 全面接管风险监测，安全员从「人查」转向「确认与整改」，现场价值提升。
安全生产法规与 ESG 要求趋严，企业 EHS 岗位扩编，第三方服务需求增长。
注册安全工程师等资格成为职业分水岭，持证与现场经验双优者溢价明显。

body: 职业健康与安全专员及技术员负责识别、评估和控制工作场所的健康与安全风险，开展隐患排查、安全培训、事故调查与合规审查，推动企业落实职业安全与健康管理。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能从传感器数据里算出风险概率，但让工人把那顶安全帽戴上、把那条整改单签字，还得靠安全员一张嘴两条腿。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can organize voting data, but a teacher still has to pull the discussion back to logic when a student falls into bias.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 21,800 postsecondary political science teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 22,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 400 jobs, with about 1,600 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $94,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary political science teachers, but it will take over material preparation. Automated organization, compilation, and courseware speed up routine lesson preparation, shifting teachers' time from finding materials toward classroom debate, research design, and value judgments. People who merely lecture from the textbook will be displaced, while those who lead seminars and conduct research are more secure.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent lesson-plan recommendations
Assisted topic generation
Research-idea assistance
Automatic organization of research-group meeting minutes
ai_s2_auto: Automatic literature organization
Automatic material compilation
Automated courseware generation
Automatic data-trend visualization
ai_s3_list: Classroom debate: people guide the logic.
Research design: people define the framework.
Value judgment: people clarify positions.
Critical-thinking guidance: people confront bias.
Responsibility: educators remain accountable in the classroom.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 places this occupation in a moderately high AI-exposure range. Material preparation accelerates substantially, but seminars and research still depend mainly on people, keeping the occupation stable overall.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. Lesson preparation accelerates, not the occupation's disappearance. Teachers who lead seminars and conduct research are more secure, while generative tools will displace textbook-only lecturers.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in political science and practice communication and research at school. Pure preparation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop seminar and debate-facilitation skills early instead of merely reading PPT slides.
Advance from preparing materials to seminars + research, use AI to improve efficiency, and pursue projects and intellectual leadership.
Emphasize teaching and supervision experience, and specify seminars you have led. Publications are preferred.
When hiring, assess more than education; look for seminar and research ability. Teachers who ignite thought deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Generative tools enter classrooms and accelerate material preparation.
Classroom debate and research design become core capabilities.
People capable of research are more secure.

body: Postsecondary political science teachers teach political theory, comparative politics, international relations, public policy, and related courses at higher education institutions. They design discussions and assessments, supervise theses and research training, and maintain teaching and research output.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary teachers, but it will change lesson preparation and grading. Generative tools accelerate lecture notes and first drafts, shifting teachers from producing materials toward setting direction, leading research, and educating students. Roles limited to presenting existing slides face the greatest pressure, while teachers with academic leadership become more valuable.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 indicates that this occupation has medium AI exposure: lesson preparation and grading are accelerated, but education and research still leave a clear role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: presenting existing slides and revising first drafts are replaced, not academic leadership roles. Teachers who conduct strong research and educate students become scarcer as efficiency rises. Those who only read from PPT slides face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build research and communication skills early during doctoral study. Pure lecturing is shrinking in the AI era, so develop leadership early.
Advance from presenting existing slides to setting direction plus mentoring students, and pursue research achievements.
Highlight achievements and student evaluations, and clearly describe your central research agenda.
Do not hire based only on degrees. Look for academic leadership and patience in educating students.

ai_s7_trends: Generative tools spread, reducing lesson-preparation time.
Evaluations place greater weight on originality and education.
Teachers with strong leadership are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically detect finished-product dimensions and surface defects, but a binding worker still has to adjust the process by hand to determine whether this paper thickness fits the spine and how to make the cut without damaging the content.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 35,800 workers were employed in 2024, projected to fall to 30,000 by 2034, a net decrease of about 5,800 jobs, with about 2,800 openings annually and median annual pay of about $39,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace print binding workers, but it will transform automation and quality inspection in finishing operations. Automated cutting lines, in-line inspection, and intelligent scheduling are spreading, shifting workers' time from repetitive single-process operation toward setting up multiple machines, final quality control, and troubleshooting. What is truly scarce is the judgment needed to keep an entire finishing line producing good work consistently.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted dimension and registration inspection
Automatic traceability of print-quality data
Intelligent scheduling for digital finishing and customized processing
Robotic palletizing and material handling
ai_s2_auto: Machines replace manual work on automated cutting and folding lines
AI vision performs in-line inspection of finished-product defects
System-based production scheduling and work orders
Digital management of supplies and inventory
ai_s3_list: Machine setup experience: only hands-on testing reveals how the same paper feeds through different machines.
Finished-product judgment: eyes and hands determine whether the spine is flat, creases align, and lamination is bubble-free.
Troubleshooting: paper jams, misalignment, and dimensional drift require rapid diagnosis on site.
Manual finishing: machines cannot match the care required for short-run case binding, box mounting, and gift packaging.
Commitment to quality: shipping one book with a crooked spine damages the reputation of the entire batch.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 indicates that this industry is midway through an automation transition: machines replace repetitive single-process tasks fastest, while setup, inspection, and manual finishing still depend on people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium risk does not mean there is no future. Pressure falls on operators who know only one process, while demand remains stable for technicians who operate multiple types of equipment, set up machines independently, and control quality. Greater versatility brings greater value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Print technology remains a viable entry path, but move toward digital operations: learn automated and digital finishing equipment, plus some color management and quality-inspection knowledge. The single-process path is narrowing.

Do not remain on one familiar machine. Learn folding, perfect binding, die cutting, and lamination to become a full-process technician. People who set up machines and understand quality are the most secure in automated workshops.

Printing-plant apprenticeships have low entry barriers. Start with paper cutting or folding, then build multi-process and machine-setup experience. Young people who work hard and learn equipment can quickly step in as veteran technicians retire.

When hiring binding workers, assess more than operating proficiency; look for machine-setup and cross-process ability. Equip veteran technicians with automation and AI inspection tools while they train newcomers to address the skills gap.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Automatic assessment of dimensions, defects, and registration

ai_s7_trends: Book and periodical printing continues to contract, while packaging and digital finishing provide the main growth.
As automation and AI inspection spread, single-process jobs decline and full-process technicians become more valuable.
Demand for customization and short runs rises, making quick-print finishing and flexible lines mainstream.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动检测成品的尺寸和表面缺陷，但「这批纸的厚度吃不吃得下这个书脊、这刀怎么切才不伤内容」，还得装订工上手调。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工人在岗约 3.58 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 3.00 万人，岗位净减约 0.58 万个，年均产生约 0.28 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.98 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代印刷装订工人，但会改造后道环节的自动化和质量检测。自动裁切线、在线检测、智能排产都在普及，工人的时间从「单工序重复操作」挪向「多设备调机、成品把关和异常处理」。真正稀缺的，是让整条后道产线稳定出好活的判断力。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助的尺寸与套准检测
印刷质量数据的自动追溯
数码印后与个性化加工的智能排产
机器人的自动码垛与搬运
ai_s2_auto: 自动裁切与折页线的机器替代
AI 视觉在线检测成品缺陷
排产与工单的系统化
辅料与库存的数字化管理
ai_s3_list: 调机经验：同一种纸在不同机器上的走纸脾气，只有试过才知道。
成品判断：书脊平不平、压痕准不准、覆膜有没有气泡，靠眼睛和手。
异常处理：卡纸、偏位、尺寸漂移，现场要快速定位原因。
手工收尾：小批量精装、裱盒和礼品包装，机器做不来那份细致。
质量责任心：一本歪脊的书发出去，砸的是整批的招牌。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行正处在自动化转型中段：单工序重复操作被机器替代最快，而调机、质检和手工收尾仍依赖人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中风险不等于没出路：被压缩的是只会一个工序的操作工，会开多种设备、能独立调机、能把控质量的技师需求依然稳定。越往后，越复合越值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 印刷技术专业依然能入行，但要往数字化方向走：熟悉自动化和数码印后设备，学一点色彩管理和质量检测知识。单一工序的路在变窄。
别停在熟悉的单台设备上，把折页、胶装、模切、覆膜都学一遍，争取成为全流程技师。会调机又懂质量的人，在自动化车间里最稳。
印刷厂学徒门槛低，先从切纸或折页做起，再往多工序和调机方向积累。能吃苦、肯学设备的年轻人，在老师傅退休后很快能顶上去。
招装订工别只看熟练度，要看会不会调机、能不能跨工序。给老技工配自动化设备和 AI 检测工具，同时带新人，是解决技能断档的办法。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 尺寸、缺陷、套准自动判定

ai_s7_trends: 书刊印刷继续收缩，包装与数码印后成为主要增量。
自动化和 AI 检测普及，单工序岗位减少，全流程技师更值钱。
个性化与短单需求上升，快印后道与灵活产线成为主流。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Network management systems can automatically identify which cell has dropped calls, but installers and repairers still use their eyes and hands to determine how to replace the RRU on the tower, adjust antenna tilt, and maintain safety.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 11,700 radio, cellular, and tower equipment installers and repairers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 12,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 1,000 jobs, with about 1,200 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $64,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace tower equipment installers and repairers, but it will accelerate monitoring and fault location. AI network management automates fault localization and work-order dispatch, shifting technicians from finding faults to climbing towers, replacing components, integrating systems on site, and performing emergency repairs. Low-level troubleshooting is most vulnerable, while certified technicians who climb towers and integrate systems become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent analysis of coverage weaknesses
Assisted antenna tilt recommendations
Spare-part forecasting and dispatch
Remote troubleshooting assistance
ai_s2_auto: Network management automatically locates cells with dropped calls
Automated work-order dispatch and closure
Automatic standing-wave anomaly alerts
Automatic upload of inspection data
ai_s3_list: Tower climbing: people maintain safety.
On-site component replacement: people provide the skill.
Coverage optimization: people provide experience.
Emergency repairs: people handle unexpected events.
Integration and commissioning: people connect the systems.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 means this occupation has moderate AI exposure in monitoring. Systems accelerate fault location and dispatch, but people retain responsibility for tower work and emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Low-level troubleshooting and dispatch are being replaced, not tower-based emergency repair. Certified technicians willing to climb and capable of integration become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those who only receive work orders and visit sites face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a communications or electronics foundation and earn working-at-height and electrician certificates while studying. Low-level troubleshooting is shrinking in the AI era, so practice integration early.
Advance from receiving work orders and visiting sites to integration + emergency response. Learn RF and network management and become a technical specialist.
Highlight tower-climbing and emergency repair cases and specify the network standards you supported. Maintenance contractors value reliability and willingness to climb.
When hiring, look beyond climbing ability to RF knowledge. Installation and maintenance technicians who integrate systems deserve higher allowances.

ai_s7_trends: AI network management improves efficiency and reduces troubleshooting.
5G and outsourced maintenance drive hiring.
Certified technicians willing to climb towers are more sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Taxi Drivers, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 204,000 taxi drivers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 226,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 22,600 jobs, with about 22,600 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $36,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace taxi drivers, but it will reshape their workflows. Tools will handle repetitive and structured tasks, while people focus on judgment, accountability, and adaptability. Routine, scripted execution faces displacement, while drivers who can apply experience to real situations and make decisions become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate assessment of passenger needs and service conditions in taxi operations.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate planning for taxi operations.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring rationale: AI can assist taxi drivers, but professional judgment and final accountability are difficult to replace, resulting in an exposure score of 4/10.

body: Taxi drivers operate commercial vehicles to pick up passengers through meters and dispatch systems. They know city roads and congestion patterns, deliver passengers safely and on time, and complete shift handovers and revenue reconciliation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Taxi Drivers, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能吞掉出租车司机的大量重复与可结构化任务，但判断、责任与人际协调仍由人扛；真正被挤掉的是纯执行层。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年出租车司机在岗约 20.40 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 22.66 万人，净增约 2.26 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.26 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.62 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代出租车司机，但会重塑Taxi Drivers的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。

ai_s2_auto: 自动生成Taxi Drivers相关的结构化文档与报告。
对Taxi Drivers的重复性数据处理与归类。
基于规则的Taxi Drivers初步筛查与排程。

ai_s3_list: 真实Taxi Drivers场景下的专业判断与权衡。
把Taxi Drivers专业知识讲给外行听的表达力。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 把 4/10 变成优势：用 AI 解放重复劳动，把时间花在真实项目、判断与人际上。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Driverless taxis are already on the road. Are taxi drivers' livelihoods still secure? The answer is yes in the short term, but the job will change over the long term.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 243,900 taxi drivers, shuttle drivers, and chauffeurs were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 260,300 by 2034, a net increase of about 16,400 jobs, with approximately 36,300 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $36,700 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI's impact on taxi drivers is already tangible. Navigation and dispatch algorithms long ago replaced memorizing routes and waiting at taxi stands, while Robotaxi services are undergoing limited trials. For now, autonomous vehicles still struggle with complex traffic, severe weather, and narrow streets in older districts, so human drivers will remain dominant for a long time. The real change is that drivers increasingly resemble a combined in-vehicle service + safety-backup role rather than pure drivers.
ai_s2_accel: Robotaxi trials in designated areas
Smart-cockpit driver assistance that reduces highway fatigue
Algorithmic platform scheduling and dynamic price adjustments
Automated parking and charging-queue scheduling
ai_s2_auto: Comprehensive replacement of route planning and real-time navigation
Automated order dispatch, fare calculation, and settlement
Vehicle-condition monitoring and maintenance reminders
Online passenger booking, payment, and review workflow
ai_s3_list: Handling complex traffic: Real-time judgment during heavy rain, accidents, and road construction.
In-vehicle safety backup: On-site response to disruptive passengers and sudden illness.
Human-centered service: Helping older adults with luggage and planning timing for passengers rushing to flights.
Flexible decisions: Resolving conflicts between system recommendations and actual road conditions.
Vehicle emergencies: Standard response to flat tires, breakdowns, and crashes.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 is relatively low. When tasks are separated, platforms have already automated the actions most easily replaced by AI, including dispatch, navigation, and fare calculation. The remaining driving and on-site response tasks are precisely what machines cannot yet handle.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: A low score does not mean safety. Autonomous driving is the long-term variable for this career. Drivers who only passively accept orders and depend entirely on platforms face the greatest concern. Drivers who build reputations in business transport, charter service, airport transfers, and related niches are difficult for AI to displace in the short term.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Treat driving as a transitional skill, not a lifelong career plan. If a student likes vehicles, commercial vehicle technology + intelligent-driving operations and maintenance offer broader opportunities than driving taxis alone.

Do not focus solely on order volume. Build business transport, charter, and accessible mobility services and develop a fixed customer base. Learn the fundamentals of intelligent vehicle systems; becoming a safety operator for autonomous fleets is another path.
If the work is temporary, prioritize a properly licensed platform with transparent commissions. For a long-term path, target combined roles in driving + service + fleet management.

Fleet recruitment should not focus only on years of driving. Evaluate service awareness and safety records. Drivers in autonomous-vehicle pilot cities can be trained as safety operators or dispatchers because people understand emergencies better than algorithms.

Drivers shift toward in-vehicle service + safety backup, with service quality dividing earnings.
Business transport, charter service, accessible mobility, and related niches become transition paths for traditional drivers.

body: Taxi drivers, shuttle drivers, and chauffeurs operate commercial vehicles to transport passengers. They plan routes, follow traffic laws, calculate and settle fares, and maintain vehicle condition, forming an important final link in urban public transportation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Driverless taxis are already on the road. Are taxi drivers' livelihoods still secure? The answer is yes in the short term, but the job will change over the long term.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 无人驾驶出租车已经上路了，出租车司机的饭碗还稳吗？答案是：短期稳，长期要变。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年出租车、接驳车司机与专职司机在岗约 24.39 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 26.03 万人，净增约 1.64 万个岗位，年均产生约 3.63 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.67 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 对出租车司机的冲击是「看得见摸得着」的：导航和接单算法早就取代了人肉认路和趴活等客，Robotaxi 也已经在小范围试跑。但现阶段无人驾驶还跑不了复杂路况、恶劣天气和窄巷老城区，纯人工驾驶在很长一段路里仍是主力。真正的变化是：司机越来越不像「驾驶员」，更像「车内服务 + 安全兜底」的复合角色。
ai_s2_accel: Robotaxi 无人驾驶在限定区域试运营
智能座舱辅助驾驶减轻高速疲劳
平台算法精细化调度与价格动态调整
自动泊车与充电排队调度上线
ai_s2_auto: 路线规划与实时导航的全面替代
接单派单与计价结算的自动化
车辆状态监测与保养提醒
乘客叫车、支付、评价全流程线上化
ai_s3_list: 复杂路况处置：暴雨、事故、施工路段下的临场判断。
车内安全兜底：异常乘客、突发疾病的现场应对。
人性化服务：帮老人搬行李、给赶飞机乘客规划时间。
灵活决策：系统建议和实际路况冲突时的判断。
车辆应急处理：爆胎、故障、事故的标准处置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 这个分数其实「偏低」：因为按任务拆分，接单、导航、计价这些最容易被 AI 替代的动作早已被平台自动化，剩下的驾驶和现场应对反而机器暂时干不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低分不代表安全：无人驾驶是这条职业线的「远期变量」。真正值得担心的是只会被动接单、完全依赖平台的司机；会跑商务专线、包车、机场接送等场景，把服务做成口碑的司机，AI 短期挤不掉。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 把驾驶当过渡技能可以，别当终身职业规划。如果孩子喜欢开车，往「商用车技术 + 智能驾驶运维」方向走，比纯跑出租的出口宽得多。
别只盯接单量，把商务接送、包车、无障碍出行这些细分场景做起来，积累固定客源。学点车辆智能系统常识，未来给自动驾驶车队做安全员也是出路。
如果只是过渡，优先选有合规资质、抽成透明的平台；长期打算的话，把目标放在「驾驶 + 服务 + 车队管理」的复合岗上。
车队招聘别只卡驾龄，要看服务意识和安全记录。无人驾驶试点城市的司机可以定向培养成安全员/调度员，人比算法更懂突发。

ai_s7_trends: Robotaxi 试点范围扩大，纯驾驶岗位在试点城市明显收缩。
司机角色转向「车内服务 + 安全兜底」，服务品质成为收入分水岭。
商务接送、包车、无障碍出行等细分场景成为传统司机的转型出口。
